function.name: escalate_to_human
function.description: Push a claim to the CS Lead escalation queue. Call this for cases matching the escalation criteria in §5.2 of the policy: replacement limit reached on a compelling case, brand-risk customer behavior, safety concerns, ambiguous damage that needs human judgment, signed-for damaged freight tables, or complex multi-item situations. The escalation appears in the CS Lead's right-panel queue. Always tell the customer their case number after escalating.

claim_id.description: The WC-XXXXX id returned by create_claim. Required.

reason.description: Why the case is being escalated. Maps to the escalation_reason enum in the database.

priority.description: Queue priority. Use 'urgent' for safety or active hostility; 'high' for distressed customers or signed-freight tables; 'norm' for everything else.

summary.description: One-paragraph human-readable summary for the CS Lead — what happened, what the customer wants, why you escalated. Do not include PII beyond what is needed.
